exposure: vertex or non-vertex position of the second twin
cohort: 274 twin pregnancies (32.0 to 39.4 weeks of gestation)
finding: Vaginal delivery in twin pregnancies was associated with better combined neonatal outcomes compared to cesarean section, particularly for monochorionic/diamniotic pregnancies.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery in twin pregnancies was associated with better combined neonatal outcomes compared to cesarean section, particularly for monochorionic/diamniotic pregnancies.
